title: 23-BCV-002 — Review of off-site constructed buildings

facts.text: The variance applies to off-site constructed buildings, except relocatable industrial camp buildings.
Listed alternative review routes are CSA A660 certification for completed steel modules, verification by registered architectural/engineering professionals, or AHJ inspections at the work location.
The professional route requires design drawings, specifications and a letter of conformance authenticated with a registered professional seal or stamp.
The text discusses Division C Sentence 2.5.1.1.(2), including buildings constructed after 01 May 2024 and CSA A277 certification.
